title: Round 11, stage 2: the kept horizon configurations continue on the evaluation's mixture of traffic
description: Round 11 (run 144, histories and weights in release model-net2-r11-state; the run published no release of its own because four of its cells did not finish) varied the episode T and the discount horizon tau at equal compute. Every arm drifted towards larger windows, the more the longer tau: at tau 20 s the mean u reached 2.0 to 2.8 (4 to 7 times the believed BDP), with 30 to 70% of its packets dropped, and the policy lost 1.5 to 2.2 to the rule on validation; at tau 1 s with 120 s episodes it matched round 10 (+0.01 to +0.02 against competitors, -0.33 to -0.40 alone). The training mixture explains part of it: competition (half of it copies) on 80% of the links leaves the flow alone on about 8% of them, against half of the evaluation's, and on large buffers a held window beats a loss-based competitor. The choice rule written before the results keeps the three configurations with the best mean over seeds of the last evaluation minus the rule: 120 s with tau 1 s (diverse, -0.175), 30 s with tau 5 s (diverse, -0.299) and 120 s with tau 5 s (dynamic, -0.716, seed 1 only; its seed 2 failed); of the arms not kept, none ended above its first evaluation after training began. The 30 s arms recovered over their second half (-0.43 to -0.24 and -0.58 to -0.36 from iteration 39 to 79). Stage 2 continues each kept cell, actor and critic, on round 12's mixture (alone 0.4, compete 0.4) with everything else unchanged, and a 4.5 h budget so that the 120 s cells end within the job limit. Validation links only; the gate runs after the last stage. CONT is T_tau_competition_links_seed.
prepare: (cd "$IN/a" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); N="$IN/v5/net1-d0.05-w512-s0/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_setup.py "$OUT/setup" --net1 "$N" --models "$IN/models" --u 0.25 --paths net2-train-xl
run: IFS=_ read -r T TAU COMP LINKS SEED <<< "$CONT"; ARM="${T}_${TAU}_${COMP}_${LINKS}"; S="$OUT/spec-r11s2-$ARM-s$SEED.json"; A="$IN/a/ppo-r11-$ARM-s$SEED"; jq --argjson t "$T" --argjson tau "$TAU" --arg comp "$COMP" --argjson links "$LINKS" --argjson seed "$SEED" --arg actor "$A.actor.pt" --arg critic "$A.critic.pt" '.algo = "ppo" | .base = "fixed" | .copies_reward = "team" | .critic_flows = true | .noise_sigma = 0.2 | .noise_hold_steps = 20 | .tau_s = $tau | .duration_ms = ($t * 1000) | .group = 4 | .links_per_iteration = $links | .lr = 0.0003 | .alone = 0.4 | .compete = 0.4 | .copies = [2, 4] | .competition = $comp | .seed = ($seed + 100) | .iterations = 200 | .eval_every = 20 | .time_budget_s = 16200 | .init_actor = $actor | .init_critic = $critic' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r11s2-$ARM-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
